summary: 3D Systems filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity program of up to $42.5 million of common stock (NYSE: DDD) through sales agent Cantor Fitzgerald, under a Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement dated November 5, 2026. Shares may be sold at prevailing market prices, as block trades, or privately negotiated, with the last reported sale on November 4, 2026 at $2.64 per share and a commission of up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. No escrow arrangement is contemplated; net proceeds uses are described separately. This is a routine shelf takedown rather than a special situation; watch dilution and selling pressure.
